title: The lost dog
grammar: past simple: telling a story in order

scene.speaker: sofia
scene.bubble: The scariest afternoon of the year: for two hours, nobody knew where Luna was…

activities.title: Put the story in order: match the moment with what happened.

pairs.right: we looked for her in the club house
we called her name in every street
we made posters with her photo
a boy phoned: she was at the bakery!
she came home with a bread gift

activities.title: Choose the correct word for the story.

activities.title: Listen to the whole story. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Sofía (narrando con emoción) y Mateo (el más preocupado).
data.script: Sofia: At three o'clock the garden gate was open… and Luna wasn't there. … Mateo: We looked in the club house, under the stairs, everywhere! … Sofia: Then we walked through the park calling her name. … Mateo: Valentina made twenty posters in ten minutes. Artist speed! … Sofia: At five, a boy phoned: a grey dog was sitting at the bakery door. … Mateo: Of course! The smell of fresh bread! … Sofia: The baker gave her water and a little bread roll. … Mateo: Now the gate has two locks. TWO!
